'''Tatrog''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He worked in the [[Olaris Spaceport|Olaris spaceport's]] mess hall in the bombed and destroyed [[City/Legends|city]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tatrog first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Companion Customization Vendor in the Olaris Mess Hall on Taris.
